renderDetails.messageTitle: Reset Clore server registration: Command may require input

content:
The command output has stabilized for 5s. The output delta since last check is:
[clore] Reset client login
[clore]   ⚠ this dumps the authorization key — you can never log in as this server again
[clore]   reset now? (y/n): 

The command appears to be waiting for input: The command is asking the user to confirm whether they want to proceed with resetting the client login by entering "y" or "n".
